name: Red Fascism
notAnIdeology: Red fascism is a label that critics apply to forms of Marxism-Leninism to equate them with fascism, not a set of beliefs that adherents hold. The Wikipedia article defines it as a term equating Marxism-Leninism with fascism, so it names a comparison, and positions that fit it are already covered by the Marxism-Leninism and fascism profiles.
